title: A single algebraic diagnostic detects structurally identical phase transitions from quarks to the cosmic horizon
source_native_claims: The ratio of geometric to arithmetic coherence (IC/F), computed from a single algebraic kernel applied to normalised physical measurements, exhibits structurally identical phase-transition signatures across systems spanning 61 orders of magnitude.
The heterogeneity gap Δ = F − IC spikes at every phase boundary tested, providing a single-number diagnostic for structural fragility independent of the underlying dynamics.

The contribution is not the AM-GM bound itself but its systematic application as a scale-independent phase-transition diagnostic across 20 scientific domains; 11,342 automated proofs across 406 physical objects confirm the three identities to machine precision.
